text:
Subject: Heater out in 4B since October 2

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in apartment 4B has been out since October 2. I phoned you on October 3 and haven't heard back.

Overnight temperatures are in the 40s °F now. Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat, so I'm hoping we can get this sorted quickly. Could the repair be done within 48 hours?

If a technician needs to come in, send me a time and I'll make sure I'm home. Replying to this email is the easiest way to reach me.

Thank you,
[name]
Apartment 4B

follow_up.question: What name would you like on the email, and which phone number or email address should Ms. Alvarez use to reach you?
follow_up.answer: I don't have a preference on the contact details. Just sign it from me, and Ms. Alvarez can reply to this email address.
